## Problem

Who encounters it, and what evidence supports it?

## Proposed outcome

Describe the smallest useful improvement and its acceptance criteria.

## Boundaries and verification

Identify effects on defaults, dependencies, privacy and frozen scientific
identities. Proposing work does not authorize scoring, calibration or changes
to the accepted environment.
